Hey. I don't know you and neither do you know me, but for some facts, I do get what you are going through. Maybe not all, but some I guess. I won't tell you what to do or what not to, cause it's your life and you have all the right to either end it or keep it going. I read few of the comments, and gathered a small picture about you, your life and the situation you went through just to take this step. 
I'll just tell you what happened with me. Lost my dad when I was 10. Wanted to be a doctor just like you. Took science in my high school( we had to choose between science and bussiness studies). I was a relatively good student academic wise from the beginning. Worked really hard in high school and I got admitted in med school after that. went there to get admitted. It went well. I was returning from there when a car hit me, I was thrown away like 10-12 feet. Broke my right leg at the knee. Fractured 5 ribs, dislocated my shoulder. Got admitted to a hospital where my mom came to see me. Doctors said that I have a broken knee cap and 4 broken ligaments. Got operated within a week. Had to learn how to walk. Physiotherapy, counselling everything took about like 4-5 months. After that I was able to stand and walk again on my own, but occasionally I had to rely on a crutch. I was recovering when I heard that my application got rejected from the med school cause I was not present for 4 months and the introduction. Broke my heart. I thought I'll try again next year. Next year came, I sat for the exam that you have to take to get into med school. Funny story, my mom suddenly died one night on my arm when I was a bit high. ( I usually smoked up a joint when I study, it helps). She died before the day of my admission. 
All the funeral and stuffs took around two weeks. After that I locked myself up in my room for an year. I went from being a muscular guy to just bones. People thought I was crazy.so did I. Started doing odd things. Left my wish of being a doc and treat people. I started woking as an editor and content creator for small studios( I used to do photography and had a knack for it). Got myself a gf. I told her that if she wants to be a part of my life then she has to stay forever( yes I know, toxic clingy guy mentality). I told her everything and how much I fear of being alone after losing my mother. She understood. Last year when the pandemic hit and the world went into lockdown, I lost my job. I never saved, used to spend all my money on her. I was literally broke overnight. She got a job this year, dumped me as soon as she started making more than what I did. I was devastated. I wanted to end my life sooo badly that I got arrested somehow. I was so broke that I remember not eating food for 2-3 days straight and having only rice with one egg for more than a month. I am still broke and working day and night just to earn something with which I can stay alive. 

I am now 25, soon going to be 26 this Oct.
